description: This file contains a module that generates PowerPoint presentations (.pptx) programmatically using the 'pptxgenjs' library. It includes functions for handling data URLs, applying transformations to data, rendering slides with placeholders, images, and fixed shapes based on a template model, as well as a public function 'generatePptx' which creates the presentation in-browser and returns the resulting Blob and filename.

methods.name: isProbablyDataUrl(v)
methods.description: Checks if a string appears to be a Data URL based on its prefix.

methods.name: fileToDataUrl(file)
methods.description: Converts a File object or a string to a Data URL, handling different input formats.

methods.name: urlToDataUrl(url)
methods.description: Fetches an external URL and converts its response to a Data URL.

methods.name: applyTransform(value, transformName)
methods.description: Applies specified data transformations such as converting bullets to lines, formatting percentages or currency.

methods.name: resolveDeckTitle(wizardData)
methods.description: Determines the title of the presentation, defaulting to 'presentation' if none is provided.

methods.name: safeFileName(name)
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to create a safe filename friendly for filesystems.

methods.name: resolveValueForStep(wizardData, slideStep, fieldId)
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a specific step in the wizard data, considering scope (globalFirst, globalLast, skillFactories).

methods.name: ptToIn(pt)
methods.description: Converts points to inches, aligning with PptxGenJS coordinate units.

methods.name: addFallbackText(slide, i, placeholderId, value)
methods.description: Adds a placeholder text to a slide when a proper value or placeholder is missing, indicating an empty or missing placeholder.

methods.name: addFallbackImage(slide, i, placeholderId, fileOrUrl)
methods.description: Adds an image placeholder or an error message to a slide if the image cannot be loaded.

methods.name: renderFixedShapes(slide, layout, templateIndex)
methods.description: Render fixed shape elements (like pictures or rectangles) specified in the layout onto a slide.

methods.name: generatePptx({ templateModel, extractedTemplate, orderedSlides, wizardData })
methods.description: Main exported function to generate a PowerPoint presentation based on a template model, extracted template, slide order and wizard data; returns the presentation Blob and filename.

ctags.name: generatePptx
ctags.pattern: /^export async function generatePptx({ templateModel, extractedTemplate, orderedSlides, wizardData/
